gate_1_placed_byte.claim: a copy placed in the asset cache under the asset's name with one byte changed is refused, and the right bytes are taken

prediction.why: the copy is hashed in full (sha256) before it is taken; any changed byte changes the hash

gate_1_placed_byte.metric: caught/N of the planted arm, flagged/N of the clean arm

control.plant: one byte of the copy XORed with a nonzero value, its position and value drawn from the seed
control.resolution: one bit: a sha256 comparison has no tolerance

gate_1_placed_byte.if_wrong: a miss is a copy taken with other bytes: the hash check is bypassed on that path
gate_1_placed_byte.cannot_discriminate_if: the copy is never read (a run that refuses for another reason counts as caught: the clean arm's 0/200 shows the path takes the right bytes)
